issues: 输入框和文字都很小（文案 44px 但框在大面积梅紫底上显得空），没有任何聊天语境
morph 时白描边框中途变成半透明，最后拼出的是一个意义不明的 L 形单瓣
三粒图元从画外落下没有落点预示，读作随机掉落
落定后只靠 ±3% 呼吸撑结尾，没有字标，结尾不是一张品牌海报
changes: look 用 custom signal：冷纸白亮场 + 12 栏淡网格（瑞士构造感），墨黑 + 钴蓝 + 一粒琥珀；品牌编为团队聊天产品 Parley，输入框上方加频道名与两条最近消息（34px），发送即退场
发送后文案 ease-in 加速飞出，钴蓝从发送键位置圆形漫开灌满输入框（全程实色），再由五量同一个 spring 把 1040×132 横条直接挤成 108×330 竖胶囊
三粒圆形图元（钴蓝碗 / 纸白字怀 / 琥珀消息点）依次落下拼成字母 P 的 mark；每粒落前 10f 槽位先画出虚线构造圆 + 十字线，落地按速度拉伸 / 压扁
拼好后 mark 左移让位、构造网格退场，Parley 196px 逐字从基线升起、口号逐词升起，尾段极缓推近 2% 代替呼吸，时长 140f → 168f
issuesEn: The input and text felt small on a large plum field, with no chat context at all
During the morph the white-outlined box went semi-transparent, and the pieces assembled into an L-shaped petal with no clear meaning
The three pieces fell in from off-screen with no hint of where they would land, so the drops read as random
After landing, only a ±3% breathing pulse held the ending: no wordmark, and the end frame was not a brand poster
changesEn: Custom 'signal' look: a cool paper-white stage with a faint 12-column grid for a Swiss construction feel, in ink, cobalt and one amber dot; the brand is a fictional team chat app, Parley, and a channel name plus two recent 34px messages sit above the input until the send

After send, the text flies off with ease-in, cobalt floods the input in a circle from the send button (solid all the way), and one spring driving all five values squeezes the 1040x132 bar straight into a 108x330 vertical capsule

Three circles (a cobalt bowl, a paper-white counter and an amber message dot) drop in turn to build a letter-P mark; 10f before each drop its slot is drawn as a dashed construction circle with crosshairs, and each piece stretches and squashes with its speed

Once built, the mark steps aside, the construction grid clears, 'Parley' at 196px rises letter by letter from the baseline and the tagline rises word by word; a slow 2% push replaces the breathing; 140f to 168f
